runnerDecision.decision: focused unittest fallback authorized by V1-R1
runnerDecision.reason: CliTestTargets only accepts tool/cli/tests/*.tests.ps1; TestTargets is Flutter; backend selection invokes fixed pytest suites. No custom standard-library Python diagnostic selector. No wrapper or unrelated verifier change added.

sourceFingerprint.algorithm: SHA256 exact bytes; .py pinned LF via local .gitattributes

schema.clientRequest: Four selected request variants with transitive definitions retained; other seven files copied verbatim from generated root/v2 schemas. Not a complete SDK or general JSON Schema validator.

sources.use: stdio framing, initialization, account methods; binary schema is execution authority
device-code beta requires ChatGPT security settings/workspace permission; no auth-cache copy used

limitations: Configuration isolation is not an OS tenant sandbox or a network traffic audit.
Client is one child/session with a single event consumer; no reconnect, hosted routing, durable credentials or inference.
Local task cancellation stops waiting; it is not server-side turn interruption.
Local logout in an empty home does not demonstrate provider-side token revocation.

packagingRecovery.issue: git diff --cached --check treated preserved CRLF in exact-byte JSON as trailing whitespace
packagingRecovery.cause: -text preserves Windows CRLF, default Git whitespace does not recognize it
packagingRecovery.resolution: scope whitespace=cr-at-eol to new receipt/schema JSON; preserve bytes and hashes; staged diff check passed
